title: MBA Reapplicant EV Engine
description: Expected-value engine for dinged MBA applicants: reapply same schools, restructure the portfolio, take the admit in hand, or skip the MBA. Models reapplicant admit probability from profile-change uplifts, prices the cycle-delay cost, and ranks improvement moves by pp-per-dollar and pp-per-hour efficiency.
data_vintage: School reapplicant statements + class profiles, 2025–26 · tier salary premium NPVs from 2024 employment reports
regulatory_citations: School reapplicant statements + class profiles, 2025–26 (HBS ~10% reapplicant class share; MIT Sloan reapplicant admit-rate statements)
Tier salary premium NPVs from 2024 employment reports (shared with AL-68/AL-69)

mcp_tool_definition.name: evaluate_mba_reapplication_ev
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compute expected value of MBA reapplication paths (same schools, restructured portfolio, matriculate admit in hand, no MBA) from admit-in-hand status, target tier, salary, and profile-change uplifts; rank improvement moves by admit-probability gain per dollar and per hour.
